title: Pardes
desc: Kishorilal chooses Ganga for his NRI son. But Ganga shares a deeper bond with Arjun, Kishorilal's foster son, leading to a conflict between duty and love.

title: Yeh Saali Aashiqui
desc: Sahil and Mitti's love turns into a nightmare after a shocking incident, teaching them the hard truth about knowing a partner before commitment.

title: Chintu Ka Birthday
desc: An immigrant family in Iraq faces chaos when soldiers storm their home during a birthday celebration, exposing them to the harsh realities of conflict and fear.

title: Jersey
desc: Arjun, a gifted yet failed cricketer, makes a daring comeback in his late thirties, driven by his dream of playing for India and fulfilling his son's wish for a jersey.

title: Lakshya
desc: Karan, a carefree youth, joins the Army but quits facing its hardships. When his actions strain his relationship, he returns determined to prove his courage and earn respect.

title: Gadar 2
desc: Tara Singh goes missing during a skirmish and is believed captured in Pakistan. His son Jeete sets out to rescue him, plunging them into a deadly maze they must escape at all costs.

title: Mr. India
desc: Arun shelters a group of orphans and is harassed by a gangster eyeing his house. After a child dies, he uses his father's invisibility watch to fight back.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Daraar
desc: Raj Malhotra, a wealthy businessman, falls for Priya Bhatia, a charming real estate agent. But when he proposes, his world shatters-Priya is already married.

title: Run
desc: Jhanvi and Siddharth are deeply in love, but her brother Ganpat, a gangster, disapproves of their relationship and plots to kill Siddharth.

title: Prem Ratan Dhan Payo
desc: A commoner named Prem swaps places with Prince Vijay Singh before a tense coronation. As plots unfold, Princess Maithili, meant to wed Vijay, finds herself drawn to Prem.

title: Raazi
desc: Sehmat Khan, a brave RAW agent, marries into a Pakistani family at her father's request. Her mission is dangerous-gathering crucial enemy secrets while risking her life.

title: Jaat
desc: In a quiet coastal village ruled by fear, Varadaraja Ranatunga's tyranny goes unchecked-until a wandering stranger's clash with his men exposes the villagers' silent suffering.

title: Bajrangi Bhaijaan
desc: Pawan, a devotee of Lord Hanuman, finds a girl, who is speech impaired, lost in Haryana. He soon learns that she belongs to Pakistan and sets out to reunite her with her family at great personal cost.

title: Silsila Hai Pyar Ka
desc: Vanshika, a simple young woman, is hired by a wealthy man to care for his son. Though the boy is spoiled at first, her presence slowly changes his outlook and their lives forever.

title: Jism
desc: Kabir, an alcoholic lawyer, falls for Sonia, wife of a wealthy traveler. She lures him into murdering her husband, but her shocking motive leaves Kabir stunned.
